s0501.literal: An edict addressed the king of Champa, ordering him to come to court in person.
s0501.idiomatic: An edict instructed the king of Champa to come to court in person.

s0502.literal: Zhao Yu, associate administrator and envoy of Java whom Sudu had dispatched, returned.
s0502.idiomatic: Zhao Yu, the Java envoy of associate administrator rank whom Sudu had dispatched, returned.

s0503.literal: Shan Prefecture and Yan Prefecture were placed under Jining Route;
s0503.idiomatic: Shan Prefecture and Yan Prefecture were placed under Jining Route;

s0504.literal: Wanquan County was restored and placed under Hezhong Prefecture;
s0504.idiomatic: Wanquan County was restored and placed under Hezhong Prefecture;

s0505.literal: Yuanqu County was transferred to Jiang Prefecture;
s0505.idiomatic: Yuanqu County was transferred to Jiang Prefecture;

s0506.literal: Guizhou Route was demoted to a prefecture;
s0506.idiomatic: Guizhou Route was demoted to a prefecture;

s0507.literal: Mianyang and Anlu were each promoted to fu;
s0507.idiomatic: Mianyang and Anlu were each promoted to fu;

s0508.literal: Jingzhao was changed to Anxi Route;
s0508.idiomatic: Jingzhao was changed to Anxi Route;

s0509.literal: Huizhou, Jianning, Wuzhou, Liuzhou, Xiangzhou, Yongzhou, Qingyuan, Binzhou, Hengzhou, Rongzhou, and Xunzhou were all changed to routes.
s0509.idiomatic: Huizhou, Jianning, Wuzhou, Liuzhou, Xiangzhou, Yongzhou, Qingyuan, Binzhou, Hengzhou, Rongzhou, and Xunzhou were all promoted to routes.

s0510.literal: The Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Temple was built in the capital.
s0510.idiomatic: The Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Temple was built in the capital.

s0512.literal: An edict ordered one hundred eight teachers and chan masters from all states to hold a feast and complete precepts ceremony at the Great Capital's Wan'an Temple, and granted them robes.
s0512.idiomatic: An edict ordered one hundred eight teachers and chan masters from all countries to hold a feast and full precept ceremony at Wan'an Temple in the great capital, and granted them robes.

s0513.literal: That year one hundred thirty-two persons were sentenced to death.
s0513.idiomatic: That year one hundred thirty-two persons were sentenced to death.

s0514.literal: In more than twenty routes including Baoding, flood, drought, wind, and hail damaged the crops.
s0514.idiomatic: Baoding and more than twenty other routes suffered flood, drought, wind, and hail damage to crops.
